newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Boeing to expand cooperation with Russia.
newsitem.headline: Boeing to expand cooperation with Russia.

text.p: Boeing Co. said Friday it planned to expand joint projects with Russia's Ilyushin and Tupolev aircraft manufacturers.
Robert Spitzer, vice president of Boeing Commercial Airplane Group, told reporters his company planned to engage in projects in the areas of air safety and spare parts certification.
Spitzer also said Boeing hoped to step up a joint project developing a supersonic airliner with Tupolev.
Last November the Tupolev Tu-144LL supersonic jet, effectively abandoned in the 1970s, began a new test flight programme using equipment supplied by Boeing.
"We have received positive responses on our projects and expect to send our experts to Russia in the very near future to definitise these projects," Spitzer said without elaborating.
